text: Image metadata shall describe type sizes/alignment/fields/references, callable parameters/results/effects, globals/rights/readiness, and native function/continuation entries. Generated ROM tables/specialized checkers shall agree with the descriptor. Runtime-private Raw/FrameRaw/count/mode carriers shall not be source pointers or forge association.
